scheduleModal.title: Adjust Task Group Schedule & Deadlines
scheduleModal.desc: Shift start dates of tasks, deadlines will automatically recalculate based on estimated days (est days) ending at 23:59:59.
scheduleModal.anchorMethodDesc: Set the start date for the earliest task; other tasks shift automatically preserving relative intervals.
scheduleModal.shiftMethodDesc: Add or subtract a specific number of days (e.g., -2 days, +3 days) for all tasks.
scheduleModal.newAnchorDateHint: Earliest task in the group will receive this date. Remaining tasks shift accordingly.
scheduleModal.shiftDaysLabel: Days to shift (+ add days, - subtract days)
scheduleModal.noTasksFound: No tasks found in this group to adjust.

importInstructions.title: Excel Task Import Format Guide
importInstructions.subtitle: Column specifications & system automation rules
importInstructions.startRuleDesc: Regardless of the Start date in Excel, the system leaves it empty by default. If assigned to an active intern via email, start date defaults to today.
importInstructions.dueRuleDesc: When a task has a start date and Est. Days, deadline is automatically calculated as startDate + (ceil(estDays) - 1) at 23:59:59. If no start date, deadline is empty.
importInstructions.adjustRuleDesc: After importing, Leaders can use 'Adjust Schedule' to shift dates for the entire group with a single click.
importInstructions.colCodeDesc: Unique task code (e.g., BE1-01, FE2-03). If matches existing task, system updates instead of creating new.
importInstructions.colOwnerDesc: Intern email. When valid, task start date automatically sets to today.
importInstructions.colEstDesc: Estimated duration (e.g., 1, 1.5, 2.5 days). Used for automatic 23:59:59 deadline calculation.
importInstructions.colPriorityDesc: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW. Default is MEDIUM.
importInstructions.colPrereqDesc: Comma-separated prerequisite task codes (e.g., BE1-01, BE1-02).
